name: std::basic_stacktrace<Allocator>::rbegin, std::basic_stacktrace<Allocator>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first entry of the reversed basic_stacktrace. It corresponds to the last entry of the original basic_stacktrace. If the basic_stacktrace is empty, the returned iterator is equal to rend().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first entry.
